body: 复古径向爆炸促销海报，3:4竖版，红黄径向背景；中心原创复古插画人物微笑并指向按钮。中文卖点准确写“夏日特惠”，按钮CTA准确写“立即选购”，顶部以原创简单圆形太阳图形作为虚构品牌标识。只有以上两段文字，中文层级清楚，复古网点印刷，人物手指自然。

en.title: Retro radial sale poster
en.description: Red-yellow radial layout with an illustrated woman pointing to the CTA. Both Chinese strings 夏日特惠 and 立即选购 are legible; a simple sun mark appears above.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

Red-yellow radial layout with an illustrated woman pointing to the CTA. Both Chinese strings 夏日特惠 and 立即选购 are legible; a simple sun mark appears above.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 23. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md#case-3-retro-style-promotional-poster). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
